paragraphs: Valarian Technologies is a dual-use technology company building critical tools to safeguard the future in an era of evolving global security challenges. You are looking for an experienced Senior MLOps / LLMOps Engineer to lead the deployment, monitoring, orchestration, and operational reliability of your production LLM applications and agentic AI platform. In this role, you will bridge the gap between AI development and production infrastructure, ensuring multi-step agentic workflows, data pipelines, and retrieval‑augmented systems run reliably, securely, and at scale within a large‑scale Kubernetes environment.

I meet the requirement for LLM, agentic and GitHub Actions through my work on an agentic system built in Python. I designed CI workflows that trigger GitHub Actions to automate the end‑to‑end lifecycle of agentic tasks, coordinating with stakeholders to validate each step. The solution stored intermediate state in PostgreSQL and leveraged Python scripts for custom tooling, ensuring reliable execution of function calling and tool execution within the agentic architecture. This experience demonstrates my ability to deliver the reliable, secure operation of LLM services that you expect.

I also satisfy the evaluation and machine learning requirement using the methods described in my second evidence set. I applied XGBoost models in R to predict churn propensity, performing systematic hyper‑parameter tuning to optimise performance. The resulting models were evaluated against hold‑out data, providing clear metrics of predictive accuracy. By focusing on rigorous evaluation, I ensured that the machine‑learning outputs met strict quality standards, aligning directly with your need for robust evaluation frameworks for AI output accuracy and drift.
